Bug_Title: Exceptions should not be created without being thrown
Bug_Explanation: This bug occurs when an exception is created without being thrown. The 'new' keyword is used to create an instance of the exception but nothing is done with the created instance. This can be avoided by using the 'throw' keyword instead of the 'new' keyword.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by not throwing the exception created in the `if` statement in the `showBug` method. This is because an exception is created but it is not thrown. The JUnit test case tries to trigger this bug by calling the `showBug` method with a negative number. It expects an `IllegalArgumentException` to be thrown.
